Industry-Leading Solutions
CPX specializes in cyber defense expertise that is designed and deployed with surgical precision to deal with any risk and any threat. Our fully vetted and globally experienced team functions as a cybersecurity special forces operation, tackling the most advanced threats facing companies, governments, and critical infrastructure entities. 

We provide end-to-end cybersecurity capabilities to ensure your compliance with stringent cybersecurity standards and accelerate your cyber maturity with robust cyber resilience services and solutions.

We help organizations build a strong OT security foundation, assess and enhance their capabilities, and maintain resilience.
